title: Test suite: TMPDIR inside a git repo and affected.py on fixture JSON

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Found during the v1.16 relay (s398, s387). `test_Verify_OutsideGitRepo_NoDriverWarning` fails when TMPDIR is inside a git repo, which is what AGENTS.md recommends (`.venv/test-tmp`). `tests/affected.py --run` refuses when a fixture JSON changes ("not a test module") instead of selecting the tests that read it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Make the outside-repo test build its fixture with `support.isolated_discovery` (or skip when TMPDIR is inside a repo) and fix the AGENTS.md advice. Have affected.py treat a changed fixture under tests/ like other non-Python files the map names.
